title: Overdrive profile
description: The rider's profile: the answer to GET /v1/profile and the body PATCH /v1/profile returns (spec §8.3, ADR 0018). One profile per service. ftp is in watts, or null when the owner has not set one (the tablet then keeps its own). wPrimeKj is the rider's W′ (anaerobic work capacity above critical power) in kilojoules for the W′ balance of spec §6.3, or null to use the service's default of 20 kJ; critical power is taken to be the FTP. zones.upperPercentOfFtp are the inclusive upper bounds of zones 1 to 6 as whole percentages of FTP (zone 7 has none); the default is Coggan's, 55 75 90 105 120 150, the same as the ride app's PowerZone, and the watts of each zone are derived from the FTP by code, never stored. weeklyAvailability is the minutes the rider can train on each weekday, null where unknown (0 is a rest day). goals are short free-text lines, at most 10. physics mirrors the ride engine's PhysicsSettings, same names and units. updatedAt is when the profile last changed (UTC), null while it is still the defaults. maxHeartRate and thresholdHeartRate (bpm, or null while the owner has not set them) are what the heart-rate load of watch activities is scaled by (spec §6.7, ADR 0023); estimatedMaxHeartRate (the highest heart rate in the stored rides) and estimatedThresholdHeartRate (95% of the best 20-minute average heart rate in the stored rides) are read-only, null while the rides do not say, and are used for the load only where the owner has set nothing. These four keys are optional so that a profile cached before they existed stays valid; the service always writes all four. bikeWeightKg (the bike's weight, writable, null or absent when not set) and riderWeight (the rider's 7-day average weight, read-only, derived from Health Connect, null or absent when there is none) are optional too and are written only when they have a value (spec §12.5, ADR 0034); so is powerProfileTable (writable: men or women, null or absent for men; ADR 0042). Rules a schema cannot state, checked by every implementation: the six zone bounds strictly increase, no goal is blank, a threshold heart rate is below the maximum when both are set, and riderWeight.date is a real calendar date.

ftp.description: Functional threshold power in watts, or null when not set.

wPrimeKj.description: W′ in kilojoules (1 to 100) for the W′ balance, or null to use the default of 20 kJ. Critical power is the FTP.

weeklyAvailability.description: Minutes available per weekday (mon to sun); null where unknown.

physics.description: The constants of the virtual-speed model (spec §4.3), as the ride engine's PhysicsSettings.

updatedAt.description: When the profile last changed (UTC, ISO-8601 with a Z), or null while it is the defaults.

zones.description: Power zones as shares of FTP.

upperPercentOfFtp.description: Inclusive upper bound of zones 1 to 6 in whole percent of FTP, strictly increasing. Zone 1 is up to the first bound, zone 2 above it up to the second, and so on; zone 7 is everything above the sixth.

maxHeartRate.description: Maximum heart rate in bpm, or null when not set.

thresholdHeartRate.description: Threshold (lactate threshold) heart rate in bpm, or null when not set.

goals.description: Short free-text goals, in the rider's words.

bikeWeightKg.description: The bike, kit and bottles in kilograms, or null when not set. Setting it is what puts the rider's weight into the physics: with riderWeight known the ride's system mass is riderWeight.kg plus this (spec §12.5, ADR 0034); null leaves physics.systemMassKg in charge.

powerProfileTable.description: Which table of watts per kilogram the power skills' levels are read against (spec §6.3, ADR 0042): men (the default) or women. Writable; null or absent means men. Written only when the owner has set it.

riderWeight.description: Read-only and derived: the rider's weight as the service has it from the weight records of Health Connect (spec §12.5): the mean of the daily weights of the last seven local days, in kilograms to one decimal, with the local date of the newest weighing that counts and how many of the seven days had one. null, or absent, when none of the last seven days has a weighing. It cannot be sent in a patch.

systemMassKg.description: Rider, bike and kit together, in kilograms.

drivetrainEfficiency.description: Share of the measured power that reaches the wheel, in (0, 1].
